text: What happen if bank send Doug one point two million dollars by mistake?
Doug wait for eighty two dollars. Only eighty two.
This is Doug.
Doug answer emergency calls. Nine one one. Doug save lives every day.
Fox the banker owe Doug eighty two dollars. Small refund.
Fox type wrong number.
Fox send one point two million.
Doug open app.
Doug blink. Doug blink again. Still one point two million.
Fox call. Mistake. Give fish back.
Doug say nothing.
Doug move fish. Fast. New account. Then another account.
Doug buy house. Big house.
Doug buy shiny car. Brand new SUV.
Life is good.
Then Sheriff Moose knock.
Theft. Bank fraud. Illegal money transfer.
Doug lose job.
Fox sue Doug. Fox want every fish back.
Doug poor.
This is called bank error.
Bank error is not a gift. Bank always find the money.
In real life, Louisiana, twenty twenty one.
A woman got one point two million instead of eighty two dollars.
She bought a house and a car.
Police arrested her. Her bank sued her too.
Doug answer emergency calls.
Now Doug is the emergency.
Would you give it back? Be honest.
Tell Doug in the comments.
